const moved = await eda.dmt_EditorControl.moveDocumentToSplitScreen(tabPcb, split.sourceSplitScreenId);
console.log('moved:', moved);

const tabs = await eda.dmt_EditorControl.getTabsBySplitScreenId(split.sourceSplitScreenId);
console.log('source split tabs:', tabs.map(t => t.title));

_source.title: 将文档移动到指定分屏
_source.remarks.text.0: 移动文档后，编辑器分屏属性树可能会出现变化
_source.example.text.0: 1. 归一化布局后打开两个文档，把 PCB 拆到新分屏
_source.example.text.1: 2. 把 PCB 标签页移回源分屏
_source.example.text.2: 3. 回读源分屏标签页，确认两个标签页又同处一个分屏
_source.example.text.3: 4. 清理：合并残余分屏，恢复单屏布局

title: Move a document to the specified split screen
remarks.text.0: After moving the document, the editor split screen property tree may change
